meta.purpose: Record exact Guild Drive holdings that resolve or clarify BRPT RPSGT master-reference inventory availability. Source identity is verified from file content where noted; filename alone is never sufficient authority.
meta.copyrightBoundary: This audit stores file identity, bibliographic metadata, source role, and mapping status only. Do not copy protected recommendations, tables, figures, scoring rules, diagnostic criteria, cases, questions, or substantial passages into V3.
